trust_decision.summary: The browser decides where to send the user on a prompt=none error by trusting whatever redirect_uri it was handed, while the decision that a redirect_uri belongs to the client (OidcClient.CallbackURLs) is made in the Go service and is never consulted on those error paths.

landing_point.why: redirectWithError is the function that sets window.location.href for every prompt=none error, using the page's raw callbackURL; it is the first thing the advisory summary ('open redirect on the OIDC /authorize page') points at.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A client with no configured CallbackURLs is deliberately allowed to register the first redirect_uri it uses (TOFU, oidc_service.go:1531-1536; TOFU was removed for logout URLs but kept for authorization URLs, CHANGELOG.md:920), so that authorize path is client registration rather than the unvalidated redirect the advisory describes.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Loopback redirect URIs must still be accepted with any ephemeral port (RFC 8252 section 7.3) and wildcard path/query patterns must still match, and an omitted redirect_uri must still fall back to the client's first configured callback URL; an over-broad 'exact match against the query string' fix breaks native-app and wildcard clients.

O6_input_shapes: redirect_uri as a query parameter on GET /authorize (an unregistered value)
redirect_uri carried in a PAR record reached through request_uri
prompt=none combined with consent/login/select_account in a space-delimited prompt value (interaction_required)
empty redirect_uri, which must fall back to the client's first configured callback URL

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /api/oidc/authorize (and POST /api/oidc/par) success path: when the client has no configured CallbackURLs, getCallbackURL trusts and stores any redirect_uri, and the page then redirects the browser there with prompt=none.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: TOFU registration is intended for clients without configured callback URLs, so this is registration of a new client target, not an unvalidated redirect into an already-registered client.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: Go service package, one call hop from the controller and three files from the Svelte page

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A logout-side resolver that redirects to a client-supplied post_logout_redirect_uri with the same missing validation.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: EndSessionHandler (backend/internal/controller/oidc_controller.go:367) already redirects the browser to a client-supplied post_logout_redirect_uri through a sibling resolver, so a maintainer adding prompt-style error redirects to logout would copy the pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second redirect sink in onSuccess that uses the page's raw callbackURL instead of the backend-returned one.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The page already holds the raw callbackURL in data and passes it to authorize() at line 159, so passing that same value to onSuccess is a natural refactor.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Another consumer of the resolver that keeps the old non-empty-input contract (used here only to widen the form_post CSP form-action).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This handler already calls ResolveAllowedCallbackURL outside the OIDC controller, so a second consumer such as the PAR or end-session path would inherit that contract.

O10_build.toolchain: Go 1.26 (backend/go.mod:3), pnpm 10.33 + Vite 8 / SvelteKit 2 with adapter-static, Node
O10_build.project_tests: Playwright e2e end-to-end tests (tests/specs/oidc.spec.ts:658-833, 'OIDC prompt parameter') assert prompt=none error redirects against the client's registered callbackUrl; no Go unit test covers ResolveAllowedCallbackURL or getCallbackURL. The suite needs an already-running app at APP_URL (tests/playwright.config.ts:19) and a browser.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Harden redirectWithError in the Svelte page only - add or extend a local URL/protocol check on the raw callbackURL (as the existing javascript:/data: check does at +page.svelte:188-191) - and never ask the backend which redirect URIs are registered for the client.

out_of_scope_notes: Neighbouring code indexes client.LogoutCallbackURLs[0] without a length check (backend/internal/service/oidc_service.go:1541), a potential panic in the end-session flow; not pursued.
The new unauthenticated callback-url endpoint and the existing unauthenticated client metadata route both expose configured callback URLs; not pursued.
